title: Lake George Tiki Tours
specs: Tours on both Lake George and Saratoga Lake
All guests must have a purchased ticket including babies and kids
Minimum 4 people required for public tours
blurb: Guests cruise around the lake on a 75-minute motorized tiki boat tour with a New York State certified Captain. They can bring their own refreshments and snacks to enjoy on board. Private tours are available for up to 16 people, and public tours require a minimum of 4 people to operate.
extraNote: Cancellations requested 10 days before booking will be refunded; within 10 days no refund · If Original Tiki Tours cancels due to inclement weather, guests may reschedule or receive a refund
